newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares close softer amid local profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares close softer amid local profit-taking.

text.p: Chilean blue chips ended slightly softer on Monday as local investors locked in gains from last week's rally while buy orders continued to flow in from abroad, traders said.
The bolsa is seen seesawing at the opening Tuesday with no clear direction, said dealers.
"It'll be a tricky day. The market closed pretty wobbly so we'll have to see what the foreigners do tomorrow," one dealer said.
The 40-share index closed down 0.16 percent at 115.7 points.
